title: ChIPseqSpikeInFree-nf pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and may only contain letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'

bam.errorMessage: BAM file must exist and end in '.bam'

antibody.errorMessage: Antibody must be provided (e.g. H3K27me3, INPUT) and may not contain tabs or commas

group.errorMessage: Group must be provided (e.g. WT, KO) and may not contain tabs or commas

color.errorMessage: Color is an R colour name or hex code (e.g. grey, #1B9E77)
